y1: Jesus called his twelve disciples and gave them power to heal the sick.
y2: Peter, Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, the other James, Thaddaeus, Simon, and Judas Iscariot. They are called apostles.
y4: Jesus sent his disciples to the villages: “Announce that the kingdom of heaven is near, and heal the sick.”
y5: “You received freely, freely give.” He told them not to take a lot of money or bags with them, but to trust only in God.
y7: “I am sending you out as sheep among wolves.” Jesus told them in advance that there would be difficulties.
y8: “Aren't two sparrows sold for a penny? But not one of them falls to the ground without your Father's permission. Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don't be afraid, you are more valuable than many sparrows.”
y10: “Everyone who acknowledges me before people, I will also acknowledge before my Father in heaven.”
y11: “Whoever gives one of my disciples a cup of cold water will certainly not lose their reward.” Jesus remembers even small acts of kindness.
verse: “So don't be afraid, you are more valuable than many sparrows.”
prayer: Dear God, thank You for caring even for a sparrow and numbering even my hairs. When I am afraid, help me remember that You consider me valuable. Let me share the love I received freely, like a cup of cold water. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: disciple. A person who follows a teacher and learns from them. Jesus called twelve disciples.
d1: apostle. It means a 'sent one'. The twelve disciples are also called twelve apostles.
d2: freely. To just give without taking money. You received freely, freely give.
d3: sparrow. A very small and common bird. In ancient times, it was sold very cheaply. God cares for even a single sparrow.
d4: hair. The strands growing on our head. A person has about a hundred thousand hairs on their head. God has numbered all our hairs.
d5: cold water. Cool and refreshing water. Jesus remembers even a cup of cold water.
